comment: Hand-transcribed expected ubus hostapd.<ifname>.del_client decisions for luci-mod-network-config-write and luci-mod-status-index-wifi from pinned uhttpd uh_ubus_allowed, network.js disconnectClient, wireless.js / 60_wifi.js callers, and ACL JSON. Not generated from the Python evaluator.
notes: uh_ubus_allowed requires session.access scope=ubus object=hostapd.* function=del_client (uhttpd omits scope; FNM_NOESCAPE).
Bounded to network.js disconnectClient rpc.declare object=hostapd.<ifname> method=del_client at luci b2e0be4b. wireless.js and 60_wifi.js call that helper.

Fixture login luci-mod-network-config-write is write of the existing luci-mod-network-config ACL group. luci-mod-status-index-wifi is write of luci-mod-status-index-wifi from luci-mod-status-index.json.
Do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant. hostapd.* wps_start / wps_cancel / wps_status are not this slice. rc.list stays on policy:ubus-rc-list-v1. rc.init stays on policy:ubus-rc-init-v1.
Missing SID is JSON-RPC ERROR_PARSE, not the all-zero sentinel.
Root list read/write '*' is stock rpcd.config, not a violation (expectation_id root-administration).
Do not emit dispatcher, authorization_violation, path_found, luci object grants, or hostapd deauth.
shellquote and basename are not sanitizers.
luci-mod-system flash.js write sysupgrade/firstboot stay unstaffed.
luci-mod-network diagnostics ping is not this slice.
crontab.js cron reload is not this slice (ubus file.write, not file.exec).

rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-base.json unauthenticated grants only luci.getFeatures
rpcd@d99f703 unauthenticated.json has no ubus hostapd.del_client
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c uh_ubus_allowed: session.access hostapd.*/del_client false -> ERROR_ACCESS
do not invent an unauthenticated hostapd.del_client grant
uhttpd@93b05e0 ubus.c parse_call_params: missing SID with no_ubusauth=0 is ERROR_PARSE
missing SID is not rewritten to 0000... in luci-ssl-25.12

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-network-config-write is not a stock device login. wireless.js uses network.js disconnectClient rpc.declare object=hostapd.<ifname> method=del_client. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b network.js disconnectClient rpc.declare hostapd.<ifname> del_client
fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-network-config-write list write luci-mod-network-config

cases.note: Fixture login luci-mod-status-index-wifi is not a stock device login. 60_wifi.js handleDelClient uses network.js disconnectClient. Intended_access, not a violation and not a PoC.
rule_refs: fixture rpcd.config login luci-mod-status-index-wifi list write luci-mod-status-index-wifi

cases.note: The read luci-mod-network-config fixture has ubus file.exec and luci swconfig methods, not hostapd.del_client. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed.
rule_refs: luci@b2e0be4b luci-mod-network.json luci-mod-network-config.read has no hostapd.*
hostapd.* del_client is write-only on luci-mod-network-config

cases.note: The list-read flash fixture has ubus file.exec, not hostapd.del_client. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed. Do not invent a write flash login.
The read luci-mod-system-init-read fixture grants rc.list, not hostapd.del_client. ERROR_ACCESS at uh_ubus_allowed.
luci.setInitAction has no luci-ssl delegated grant at luci b2e0be4b. This slice is hostapd.del_client, not the luci object method.
rule_refs: do not invent a setInitAction luci-ssl grant

cases.note: ACL pattern hostapd.* does not match object hostapd (no BSS suffix). network.js uses hostapd.<ifname>.
luci-mod-status-index-wifi write grants hostapd.* wps_start. 60_wifi.js handleCallWPS uses that method. This slice does not emit a wps_start grant.
Stock root list read/write '*' is intended_access (root-administration), not a violation.
rule_refs: openwrt@4e964251 package overlay rpcd.config root read/write '*'
